messages:
rachel: heads-up  we need a singlepage solution brief that sales can send after the webinar. must combine security controls, SLA highlights, and a short deploy-mode decision strip. design: single column so it prints well.

tom: +1. keep it tight: top one-line value prop, three boxes (Security, SLA & Reliability, Deploy Modes + Tradeoffs), and two CTAs: Request Trial / Book Solutions Call.

priya: for security wording use cautious language: "supports customer-managed KMS, optional HSM, audit logs, SIEM integrations, and configurable data residency." flag for legal for exact compliance phrasing.

samir: SLA box: state target SLOs by deployment mode (hosted: best-effort, dedicated: latency tiers with SLOs, private: customizable). include a short "what happens at capacity" line (auto-fallback and notification). add one-line incident response window.

rachel: benchmark callout idea: "Provisional microbench: 95th pct latency ~85-110ms on Dedicated for 8k context (KV warm). Estimated ~$0.48 / 1k tokens for a typical assistant workload. Engineering to confirm." mark provisional.

tom: marketing ops: when someone downloads the brief, create an inbound lead and set tag `enterprise_deploy_brief_v1`. Capture fields: account_size, compliance_requirement, requested_feature, desired_trial_start. routing pseudocode below.

ops-bot: routing pseudo (ops can implement):
```
lead = form_submission
lead.tag = "enterprise_deploy_brief_v1"
if lead.account_size >= 2000000:
  assign_to("Enterprise_AE_Team")
  lead.priority = "p0"
elif lead.compliance == true:
  assign_to("Solutions_Engineering")
  lead.priority = "p1"
elif lead.requested_trial == true:
  assign_to("Growth_AE_Pool")
else:
  assign_to("Inbound_Sales")
```

priya: add `security_priority` field to the form (high/medium/low) so SEs can triage. also include `requested_feature` to help PMs spot demand.

samir: include a short sales play section: three qualifying q's (data residency, peak qps, audit cadence) and top objections + rebuttals. AEs should have a 30s script.

rachel: webinar follow-up plan: send 1-email with PDF attached, link to recording, and a short form that auto-tags leads. email CTA text: "Download the Enterprise Deploy Brief (1 page)".

legal-bot: note: avoid claiming "compliant" with any standard. use "supports controls to meet X" phrasing and submit to legal review before publish.

tom: timeline: copy draft by Tue, design by Thu, ops to wire SFDC routing by Fri, legal + infra signoff next week.

priya: i'll draft the security checklist and the exact legal-safe phrasing. samir: i'll chase infra for conservative bench numbers and label them provisional.

rachel: also include a tiny diagram showing failover path (Dedicated -> Hosted) and a oneline ROI for finance: "Predictable pertoken unit cost and reduced infra ops vs selfhosting." keep numbers conservative.

tom: once draft is in Google Docs, i'll add design notes and export PDF. ops, please confirm SFDC fields: account_size, compliance_requirement, requested_feature, desired_trial_start, security_priority.

ops-bot: doc created: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1enterprise-deploy-brief-draft (marketing,sales) :white_check_mark:

rachel: great. i'll post the doc in #marketing when ready and ping AE leads. thanks team :rocket:
